question: A warehouse had 90 boxes initially. They removed 86 damaged boxes. They multiplied by 6 for restocking. They removed 8 for urgent orders. They added 58 from suppliers. They multiplied by 7 for shipping. The facility had 20 workers. How many boxes for shipping?

In the morning, a company had 171 units. By midday, production increased 7 times. By afternoon, 77 units were added. By evening, 46 units were added. Their total then increased 9 times. Converting to hundreds, how many units do they have?

Ola had 184 dollars in her savings jar. For her birthday her grandfather doubled what was in the jar, and her aunt added 10 dollars. Ola then took 340 dollars out of the jar to buy a laptop. After that her mother put 69 dollars into the jar for good exam results. How many dollars are in Ola's jar now?

A market garden records its crop in single cucumbers rather than in kilograms. On Monday morning each of the 3 rows was picked and gave 34 cucumbers. By the afternoon 5 greenhouses had been picked in exactly the same way. That evening a second picking doubled the day's total. The site has 12 water tanks. The cucumbers were then shared equally between the 4 shops the site supplies. How many cucumbers did one shop receive?

Wes, who is 9 years old, was allowed 123 minutes of screen time on each school day. His parents cut that by 63 minutes and then by another 11 minutes a day. There are 5 school days in a week, and at the weekend he gets a bonus of 72 minutes on top of his school-day total. His parents kept this weekly plan for 5 weeks, which felt like a dozen years to Wes. How many minutes of screen time did Wes get over those 5 weeks?

A builder started with 174 tasks. He multiplied by 4 for crew size. He multiplied by 9 for daily throughput. He added 39 from additional scope. He subtracted 3159 for subcontracted work. He subtracted 2855 for consolidation (converting to in-house tasks). Michael and two leads compared workload. What was the in-house task count?

A small company had 215 dollars. They earned 62 dollars from sales. They earned 65 more dollars. They earned 25 more dollars. They doubled their earnings. They multiplied by 4 for reinvestment. They worked 240 minutes, which is 4 hours. They divided by 4 for equal distribution. How much per person?

In the morning the rental shack had 24 kayaks lined up on the beach, and 32 more were unloaded from the truck. In the afternoon 53 kayaks came back from a group tour and 22 came back from private renters. In the evening 95 kayaks were loaded onto trailers for winter storage. How many kayaks are left on the beach?
A supplier started with 58 units. She added 6. This was divided by 2. She removed 11. This was multiplied by 5. Then multiplied by 3 for batch sizing. Measured in hours per unit, what was the total?

A single fruit basket started the morning with 33 apples. A neighbor took 27 apples for a pie. Half of what remained was given to a food bank. A squirrel got into the basket and took 2 more apples. A friend then added 26 more apples. Finally, the basket's apples were split evenly among 3 baskets, and this story follows just one basket. How many apples were in that one basket in the end?

A toy store began the morning with 226 puzzle boxes on the shelf. A wholesale order removed 106 boxes. Unrelated to puzzles, a nearby craft store restocked 800 rolls of ribbon that same morning. A clearance sale removed 95 more boxes. A donation added 9 more boxes. A late shipment added 31 more boxes. A regional order required the store to prepare 4 times that total. How many puzzle boxes did the store need for the regional order?

On Monday morning a playground project had 43 bags of wood chips on site, and a second lorry doubled that number before lunch. In the afternoon a supplier delivered 58 more bags. On Tuesday the council sent 35 bags. On Wednesday evening a landscaper dropped off another 58. How many bags of wood chips are on site now?

The puzzle club started the term with 98 blank sheets of card, and it times its rounds in seconds rather than in minutes. The club has 32 members. It turned out that 13 sheets were water damaged and had to be binned. Each usable sheet was printed on both sides to give 5 pages, and every page carried 6 puzzles. When the editors checked the set, 800 puzzles were duplicates and were struck out. Each puzzle that survived the check is worth 9 points in the end-of-term contest. How many points are on offer?

A coach had 97 basketballs initially. He multiplied the supply by 4 through donations. He removed 278 old balls for recycling. He added 75 new balls from inventory. He doubled the final count for tournament preparation. The gym budget was 2000 dollars. How many basketballs did the coach have ready?

A student had 14 reference books initially. She removed 8 outdated books, leaving 6. She added 30 new books, reaching 36. She divided into 2 equal libraries of 18 books each. She removed 4 books for repair. Her roommate has 50 books (separate collection). How many books remain in her collection?

A toy store had 187 building-block sets in stock before the holidays. A big sale moved 78 sets out the door in one weekend. A restock order then turned every remaining set into 9 sets. A late shipment added 14 more sets, arriving after a drive that took '120 minutes, or two hours.' A holiday rush then sold 584 sets in a single week. A final clearance event turned every remaining set into 5 sets. How many building-block sets were left after the clearance event?

A small-town library kept 161 titles in its local-history collection. A retired teacher donated 22 more titles, an estate sale added 73 titles, and a grant paid for 78 more. The library then decided to hold 8 copies of every title in the collection. How many copies of local-history books did the library hold?

Two colleagues compared effort: one had 130 units. She multiplied by 9 for daily scaling. She multiplied by 5 for weekly factor. She divided by 3 for team sharing. She multiplied by 3 for restoration (measured in final effort units). Throughout the week, morning prep, afternoon work, and evening review tracked one continuous effort progression. Marcus had 18 units (separate tracking). What was the final effort unit count?

Early on Wednesday a courier had 75 parcels in his van. He delivered 21 of them before the morning break and another 52 during the rest of the morning. At the depot at lunchtime he loaded 75 fresh parcels for the afternoon round. Before the evening cut-off he handed 18 parcels over to a collection point. The courier logs his driving time in minutes, although his contract counts it in hours. How many parcels were still in the van at the end of the day?

A pharmacy tracked the total number of pills in a large stock bottle, starting with 143 pills. A prescription used 72 pills. A second prescription used 41 more. A third prescription used 22 more. The pharmacist then repackaged the remainder into 7-pill travel packs, multiplying the tracked count by 7 to represent the total pills across all packs — converting from bottle count to pack-pill count, a simple unit change. Finally, a damaged pack removed 6 pills from the tracked total. How many pills did the tracked pack total show?

A project had 226 deliverables. They added 43 deliverables in morning planning. They multiplied by 6 for team assignments. They divided by 6 for consolidation. They added 5 items from scope creep. They subtracted 182 items for delegation. They subtracted 42 items for external contracting. Throughout the project, morning meetings, afternoon execution, and evening progress reviews measured one continuous timeline, though Maria tracked 18 items from a different phase. What was the final deliverable count?

In the morning Nico packed 58 grapes in his lunch box, and his friend Ada, who had only 54 grapes and so slightly fewer than Nico, tipped hers into his box so he could carry them. At morning break Nico ate 41 grapes from the box. In the afternoon he gave 43 grapes to the football team. In the evening he ate 17 more on the bus home. How many grapes are left in Nico's lunch box?

In the archive's new storage system, each folder holds 143 scanned pages, a project is made of 7 folders plus a 25-page index that is stored alongside them. Each drive stores 8 such projects, each rack holds 8 drives, and the server room has 8 racks. The room is 30 metres long, and the archivist has worked there for a dozen years. How many scanned pages does the server room hold in total?

Ola had 15 marbles. Her brother Bo had twice as many marbles as Ola. Bo won 37 marbles at recess, then lost 18 in a game after school. His uncle gave him 66 marbles for his birthday. How many marbles did Bo have then?

Two friends, Camille and Theo, tracked video game currency, and Theo's balance stayed lower than hers all season. Camille began with 42 gold coins in the game, and a boss battle reward made that grow to 9 times its size. A side quest then added 66 more coins. Her total was split evenly between 2 in-game accounts, and only one account was tracked. Since the game displays currency in coins but the store menu prices items in gems, Camille always checked the conversion rate before buying. A final login bonus added 68 more coins. How many coins were in that account?
